title.narrative: Enhancing Access to Lifesaving Health, Nutrition, and WASH Services for Displaced Populations and Famine Response in Aldaba

description.narrative: ltpgtFighting between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) has led to a nationwide humanitarian crisis. An estimated 10.7 million people have been displaced since April 2023. Health facilities (HFs) are over-burdened beyond their capacity, particularly in areas that have recently received a large influx of displaced persons. access and utilize a huge concern related to HFs are ill-equipped to handle such cases. Many essential medical services remain unavailable. Since the onset of the conflict, at least 67% of HFs located near conflict areas are out of service, as of 31 May. Out of 89 main hospitals in the capital and states, 60 are out of service, while 29 are operating fully or partially (some provide emergency medical services only), but they are at risk of closure due to shortage of medical staff, supplies, water, and electricity. At least 17 hospitals have been shelled and 21 hospitals have been forcibly evacuated since the beginning of war, while 11 ambulances were attacked, and others were not allowed to pass to transport patients and delivery .ltbrgtUNOCHA estimates 14.3 million people equating to 30% of the population will require humanitarian assistance. To address these needs MedGlobal proposes an integrated health, nutrition, and WASH programming, supporting Ad Dabbah hospital along with mobile teams supporting Ad Dabha locality in coordination with the ministry of health. MedGlobal intends to improve the delivery of integrated essential health services by providing material and operational support to the facilities with complementary mobile teams to ensure the availability of essential health services integrating WASH and nutrition ,31,225 beneficiaries from Nutrition activities ,70,500 those will be benefit from health services (total consultation ,ANC ,PNC ,family planning, referral, and capacity building) ,32,710 will benefited from WASH ( Water tracking,sanitaion,and hygiene campaignaa,and WASH Supplies).ltbrgtMedGlobal will collaborate with its Sub-Implementing Partner (Sadagaat Charity Organization) to sustain efforts in critical areas.
